messages:
alex chen: Hey team — I accepted the org invite but when I try `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git` I get `ERROR: Repository not found` (404). I do have 2FA enabled. Who should I ask about repo perms?

infra-bot: @alex chen The org membership is confirmed but you're not a member of any infra teams. Private repos will 404 if you don't have repo-level access. Can you confirm your GitHub username?

alex chen: my GitHub handle is alex-chen (public profile). I thought onboarding put me on infra-viewers?

emily ryan: @chris wong can you check the team sync? New hires should be added to infra-viewers by default via the onboarding group.

chris wong: Looking. IdP provisioning didn't include alex's account because the primary email on GitHub (alex.work@gmail.com) wasn't mapped to Okta. I'll add him manually to infra-viewers for now and fix the IdP mapping.

chris wong: Ok added to team infra-viewers and gave read access to redwood/infra-config (1760456902). Try again after signing out of GitHub and re-cloning.

alex chen: Re-signed in, still 404 when cloning. Error snippet: `git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git: Permission denied (publickey). fatal: Could not read from remote repository.` I do have an SSH key on my account.

devex-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm SSH key present in Settings -> SSH and GPG keys on GitHub 2) Ensure key is verified/added to the correct account 3) If using GitHub CLI oauth, try `ssh -T git@github.com` to debug.

alex chen: `ssh -T git@github.com` returns `Hi alex-chen! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.` so auth works but git still errors.

chris wong: Hmm SSH auth ok. Are you on a corp laptop with git signed commits/tagging hook? Also check that your local remote is `git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git` and not an https url with cached creds. Run `git remote -v`.

alex chen: remote -v shows `origin git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git (fetch)`. Weird. I tried `ssh -vvv git@github.com` and saw the key being used.

chris wong: I escalated to GitHub SSO sync: looks like team add was pending approval due to SSO provisioning policy. I forced a manual SSO grant for your account (1760456988). Try now.

alex chen: Cloned successfully! :tada: Thanks. One last question: who do I ping to get write access to infra-config for making infra-as-code PRs?

emily ryan: @alex chen open a PR against the infra-onboarding board or ping me. We approve write access after 1 week and a short pairing session for infra changes.

alex chen: Perfect, thanks everyone — saved me a ton of time.

devex-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.dev/onboarding/github-access has the standard steps for SSH, SSO, and team membership.
